Harbor Mutual Insurance Company
Personal Auto Policy: Declarations Page
Policy number: HM-AU-0048-4821
Named insured: Alex Sample, 1200 Maple Court Way, Unit 4B, Springfield
Policy period: April 30, 2026 to October 30, 2026
Renewal: This policy renews automatically for another six-month term unless you or Harbor Mutual cancels it before the expiration date.
Insured vehicle: 2021 Honda CR-V EX
Total premium for this period: $684.00, billed every six months.
Coverages and limits
Bodily injury liability: $100,000 per person / $300,000 per accident
Property damage liability: $100,000 per accident
Collision: $500 deductible
Comprehensive: $250 deductible
Uninsured motorist: $100,000 per person / $300,000 per accident

Exclusions
This policy does not cover loss while the vehicle is used to carry people or property for a fee, including delivery or rideshare driving.
This policy does not cover intentional damage caused by an insured person.
Reporting a claim
Report any accident or loss to Harbor Mutual within fourteen (14) days of the date it occurs.
Call the 24-hour claims line at 1-800-555-0177 or email claims@harbor-mutual.example.
Do not admit fault or agree to a settlement before speaking with a claims representative.
